cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Your hands save lives. Keep them free.

cues.speaker: NURSE
cues.text: Hey Lumi, scan patient.
notes: Pause briefly after “Hey Lumi.” Scanning begins at 00:06.00.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Scan the wristband. Confirm with a tilt.
notes: Leave the right tilt at 00:09.63–00:10.37 unspoken.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Patient details, why they’re here, allergies, and prescribed medication. Right in your field of view.

cues.speaker: NURSE, TO PATIENT
cues.text: I’m going to check your blood pressure.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Help needed. Room twelve.
notes: The request appears at 00:24.00; the left tilt runs from 00:25.83 to 00:26.50.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Hands occupied? Tilt left to decline.

cues.speaker: NURSE
cues.text: Hey Lumi, capture reading.
notes: Pause briefly after “Hey Lumi.” Capture begins at 00:33.00.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The reading is captured, ready for your review.

cues.speaker: NURSE, TO PATIENT
cues.text: Here is your prescribed medication.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Then document it, without touching a screen.

cues.speaker: NURSE
cues.text: Hey Lumi, add patient note.
notes: Pause after the wake phrase. The listening card appears at 00:47.00.

cues.speaker: NURSE, DICTATING
cues.text: Forty milligrams Orion Furosemide, one tablet,

cues.speaker: NURSE, CONTINUING
cues.text: given to Mark Pokidko,

cues.speaker: NURSE, CONTINUING
cues.text: by nurse Jooyeon Lee at fifteen thirty,

cues.speaker: NURSE, CONTINUING
cues.text: for high blood pressure.
notes: Read the four dictation blocks as one sentence, with natural pauses at the indicated breaks. Each time range is a recording window; follow the word reveals without chopping speech into individual words.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: You review. You authorize.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: A right tilt saves the record.
notes: The tilt runs from 01:09.00 to 01:10.00. Saved confirmation appears at 01:10.00. Leave 01:10.00–01:13.00 quiet.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Code Blue. Room eight.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: One tilt. The handover is already in view.
notes: Acceptance is at 01:17.27; the ISBAR card appears immediately. Let viewers read the handover instead of rushing through every detail aloud.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Because every second matters.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Lumi. Focusing on the patient.
notes: Pause after “Lumi.” Let the closing card breathe; no further speech before the end at 01:29.00.
